FLASHCARD SET · AGES 3–4 YEARS

Big & Little Letters Together

Twenty-six cards showing each big letter and its little letter side by side — Aa to Zz — the classic first matching pair for preschool hands and eyes.

THE CARDS

All twenty-six, ready to download.

Tap any card to open its picture page with the words to say together — or tap Download to keep the letter card itself. Every card below has its own download button — the full-size pair card, straight from this page.

HOW TO USE THESE CARDS

Little ways that work.

  1. 01

    Guessing first

    Pick three cards, lay them face up and say each letter sound together. Three cards is a lovely little class.

  2. 02

    Keep it short

    A few cards a day beats the whole alphabet in one go. Stop while your preschooler is still having fun.

  3. 03

    Tape one up

    Put today’s card at eye level — the fridge, a door. Passing it again and again is quietly powerful practice.

  4. 04

    Match with the picture set

    Lay a variant card beside its picture card from the Alphabet A–Z set and let your child find the pair.
